test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Up in the air

options.text: Something that is tossed up in the air
Something that is certain and decided
Something that is invisible and unattainable

solution:
The correct answer is __**Something that is unknown entirely**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **idiom **is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words
 
• The idiom** Up in the air** means something that is not known,
 
• Example : Lisa is pregnant was **up in the air** for me.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Some more idioms on **Air **are :

 
• **Full of hot air **- talking nonsense

*Example *: What happened to Alison , she is** full of hot air** today.

 
• **To clear the air **- Discussing things to sort situation.

*Example* : I feel we need **to clear the air **first.

 
• **Something is in air** - something unknown is happening

*Example *:**Something's in air** but what?
